still._prompt_sleek_note: First sweep (work/riot/shaded/): every seed a slender humanoid with an amber visor. 'humanoid robot, android' pulls toward a slim figure, and the shoulder lamp's amber took the visor.
still._chosen_note: heavy seed 10, mirrored to face right: the one clean profile T-pose of the sweep with the boxy torso, thick armoured legs and the cyan visor slit on top. No shoulder lamp was drawn (it is painted by a box recolour on the torso).
still._key_note: The still's floor shadow closes off the background between the legs from the border; a seed there keys it, and the shadow strip under the soles is cleared.

target._settings_note: Dani's target block; 62 art px tall in a 48x68 frame (96x136 screen), collider 60x100 screen px unchanged, feet on its bottom edge. Steel ramp, cyan visor, amber lamp.

rig._comment: Joints in still pixels (832x1216, mirrored to face right). The still is a stride: the near thigh leans 22 degrees forward and the shin 15, so the leg parts carry rest angles that stand them straight for the poses (thigh +22, shin -7, foot -15: a bone pointing down-right is at a negative screen angle, summing to zero so the pose file's flat() still levels the sole). The near arm is the extended one (rest 90). The far arm and far leg are discards, replaced by darkened copies. The lamp is a small part claimed on the near shoulder and painted amber: the still drew none.
